topic: Third Row Map Lamp Control Interface Specifications
row_semantics: Each row represents a distinct interface signal related to the third-row map lamp control system, detailing its direction, type, sender, receiver, and specific signal values.

column_semantics.Interface Name: The name of the interface signal (e.g., ThirdRowMapLampRHSwReq).
column_semantics.Direction: Indicates whether the signal is an input or output.
column_semantics.Sender/Provider: The module or component that sends or provides the signal (e.g., RHZCU).
column_semantics.Receiver/Consumer: The module or component that receives or consumes the signal (e.g., RHZCU).
column_semantics.Channel: The communication path for the signal (not specified in this table).
column_semantics.Source: The origin of the interface (not specified in this table).

core_entities.description: Request signal for the third-row map lamp switch state.

core_entities.name: ThirdRowMapLampRHBrtLvl
core_entities.description: Signal indicating the brightness level of the third-row map lamp.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the interface signals for controlling and monitoring the third-row map lamp, including switch requests, brightness levels, and status information, which can be used to verify the correct functionality and response of the lamp control system under various conditions.
